header.description: Differential corpus for src/evm.rs. For every case: viem's unsigned serialization, its keccak signing hash, and its signed serialization. Cases with high_s also give the high-s form of the same signature (s = n - s, y_parity flipped); the contract must reproduce the canonical signed bytes from it.
header.tx_shape: EIP-1559 value transfer: empty data, empty access list
header.regenerate: In a directory with `npm install viem@2.57.16`: node <repo>/contract/vectors/gen-evm-corpus.mjs > <repo>/contract/vectors/evm-corpus.json
header.signing_key: keccak256 of the string "minder evm corpus test key v1": derived from a public string, controls no funds, not a secret. Signatures are viem sign() with RFC 6979 nonces, so they are deterministic and low-s.
header.encoding: numbers are decimal strings; byte strings are 0x-prefixed lowercase hex; r and s are 32-byte padded; y_parity is 0 or 1
header.tip_not_above_fee: every transaction satisfies max_priority_fee_per_gas <= max_fee_per_gas and chain_id >= 1, as viem and the contract both require
